headline: GRINDR 🍆 PAYS £26M 💰 to SETTLE 🧾 HIV STATUS 📊 CLAIMS 😱
text:
GRINDR 🍆 has finally 🏁 agreed 🤝 to cough 💦 up a juicy 🍑 £26M 💰 settlement 🏦 to bury 🪦 the massive 👀 lawsuit 🧑‍⚖️ over claims it was allegedly 🕵️ sharing 📤 users' personal 🧍 info including their literal HIV 🦠 status with random third 🥳 parties without consent 🙅!! The world's 🗺️ largest 🌍 LGBTQ+ 🏳️‍🌈 dating 💘 app got sued ⚖️ in the High 🏛️ Court last year 📅 over straight up MISUSING 🙊 people's private 🕳️ data like a thirsty 📱 ex who can't stop oversharing 🍆!! Class action 🧑‍🍳 crew signed up over eleven thousand 😱 claimants 📋 and they're getting two fat £13M 💸 payments 💰 one by December 31 🗓️ and the rest by March 2027 🗓️ with zero admission of any guilt 🙊!!

WAB DADDY 🐺 Grindr stressed these were just HISTORICAL 📜 data practices before 2020 when that Chinese firm Kunlun 🇨🇳 owned the whole 🍆 thing and they swear they've overhauled 🛠️ everything since becoming publicly listed 📈 in 2022!! The US Securities 📜 and Exchange Commission filing dropped on September 2nd 🗓️ saying while they dispute every allegation 🧐 they still acknowledge the distress 😣 and loss of trust from UK users back in that pre-2020 era 🌫️!! Austen Hayes law firm led the charge claiming Grindr was feeding sensitive ethnicity 🧬 sexual orientation 🏳️‍🌈 and even HIV test dates 📆 to data bros Apptimize 📊 and Localytics for ad customisation like some sleazy matchmaker 🧑‍❤️‍💋‍🧑 pimping out your bedroom secrets!!

People on the app can optionally share their HIV 🦠 status plus last test date to reduce stigma 🌈 facilitate conversations 🗣️ and help make informed health choices but apparently that data got passed around like party favors 🎉 to potentially unlimited third parties before they slammed the brakes in 2018!! Chaya Hanoomanjee the lead lawyer dropped that claimants experienced significant distress 😭 over their most sensitive private info being shared without consent and that Grindr owes the entire LGBTQ+ community 🏳️‍🌈 compensation for the compromised data breach 💥!! Norway's data watchdog hit them with a £5.5M fine earlier and the UK Information Commissioner's Office gave them a stern reprimand later so this monster payout is basically the climax 🍆 after years of edging the regulators!!

Grindr defended the practice back then as totally in line with industry standards 🏭 but quickly stopped sharing the HIV data with those analytics firms after the 2018 revelations hit the fan 🌀!! The company insists it has now completely overhauled its privacy practices 🛡️ to meet the unique needs of its community and remains a safe space 🏠 for users with transparency 🔍 user control 🎛️ and responsible data handling!! While they keep repeating no liability was admitted the two chunky £13M payments will still land one before New Year's Eve 🎆 and the second before spring 2027 leaving the app free to keep swiping without that old baggage dragging on its nuts 🍒!! Some bystander in the comments was like bro they really got caught slipping on the down low 🫣 but at least the community is finally getting paid for the trauma!!

The filing made it crystal clear this settlement covers only the UK side of the drama and Grindr is still committed to being the safe horny haven 🏳️‍🌈 it claims to be after all the post-2020 changes!! They used to target victims according to police whispers but now with fresh ownership and public listing 📊 the app swears it's built different 💪 with actual consent mechanisms in place so users can share their status without fearing it gets auctioned off to every ad network on the block!! This whole saga started with revelations that had the community shook 😱 yet here we are watching WAB DADDY 🐺 Grindr write one last massive check to make the past disappear like it never railed their trust in the first place!!
